To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the best reforestation plan for a given site depends upon the following: (1) the harvest system; (2) the species; (3) the site conditions; and (4) the objectives.
the most important factor in successful reforestation is to plant seedlings of a target species in an area with the right site conditions.

the most important variables in successful regeneration by planting are: 1) the species of seedling and its ability to establish under prevailing conditions, 2) the seedling's ability to grow under the site environment, and 3) the site's ability to provide a favorable seedling environment.
